targets.name: deepseek/api
targets.notes: the lab's own API; deepseek-flash is the current V4.1 Flash alias; thinking disabled so answers are comparable; floor measured on the same deployment, runs 20260923T214043Z vs 20260924T015801Z: 0.40 exact, 0.62 prefix, sampled test agrees

targets.name: deepseek/api-thinking
targets.notes: the lab's own API in its native mode: thinking on at high effort, as a client gets it by default; its own family so it is compared with itself over time; floor measured on the same deployment, runs 20260923T214043Z vs 20260924T015801Z: 0.15 exact, 0.29 prefix, sampled test agrees; in reasoning mode the temperature-0 answers vary with the chain of thought, so the deterministic test is weak and the sampled test carries the verdict

targets.name: deepseek/api-pro

targets.name: deepseek/api-pro-thinking
targets.notes: DeepSeek V4 Pro in its native mode (thinking on, effort high); floor measured on the same deployment, runs 20260923T214043Z vs 20260924T015801Z: 0.20 exact, 0.37 prefix, sampled test agrees; in reasoning mode the temperature-0 answers vary with the chain of thought, so the deterministic test is weak and the sampled test carries the verdict

targets.name: zai/api-flash
targets.notes: Z.ai's own API; reasoning cannot be switched off, effort low keeps answers comparable; no logprobs, so the battery is the only check; fingerprint by sampling (8 answers per prompt, every 1 h) because the lab returns no token probabilities; deterministic thresholds calibrated 25 Sep 2026 (GLM is not deterministic at temperature 0: exact 0.10)

targets.name: zai/api
targets.notes: Z.ai's own API for GLM-5.3; reasoning cannot be switched off, effort low; no logprobs, so the battery is the only check; fingerprint by sampling (6 answers per prompt, every 6 h) because the lab returns no token probabilities; deterministic thresholds calibrated 25 Sep 2026 (GLM is not deterministic at temperature 0: exact 0.10)

targets.name: moonshot/api
targets.notes: Moonshot's own API; reasoning cannot be switched off, effort low; logprobs refused by the API, so the battery is the only check; the API accepts temperature 1 and top_p 0.95 only, so deterministic probes run sampled and their thresholds come from calibration; fingerprint by sampling (6 answers per prompt, every 6 h) because the lab returns no token probabilities
